description: 台灣中油公司液化石油氣牌價 [fuel stations and oil and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 自2020年12月份後，配合政府政策價格未調整，故牌價生效時間為2020年12月2日 蒐集目的：本資料集主要提供台灣中油公司各類液化石油氣牌價查詢(含歷史及最新牌價資訊)，以便客戶詢價使用。 資料來源為公司內部資料。 微軟教學文件：加入和移除 Web Service microsoft. com/zh-tw/l... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml, json. The portal shows 2025-10-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
